positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Projects: Marina Bay Sands, Adidas, CNM LLP, MedHelp, Grub Hub, Probus Insurance, IIFL, NPCL
	Developed, Designed, and Modeled RPA, BPM/Workflow processes using Python, C#, .NET, REST, SOAP API, SQL, JSON, JavaScript, Microservices, Service Oriented Architecture to deliver timely production deployments.
	Orchestrated Intelligent Automation Development, designed, and developed Software Bots using Python, Natural Language Processing NLP, Machine Learning ML, API integration, Optical Character Recognition OCR, and Contextual Learning by RPA tools to deliver productive and timely solutions.
	Experienced Agile development cycle using Scrum, including backlog development, iteration planning, SDLC, and iteration tracking. Also, worked with business and technology teams to analyze and assess solution feasibility.
	Developed Python libraries and customized Python APIs for extended solution integration and performance improvements.
	Managed real time data by programming solution using Efficient, Scalable, Reusable Python, C#.

positions.title: Project Trainee
positions.description:
Projects: QR Codes Decodability Improvements using Error Correction Levels
	Worked on development of C++ AP'Is for different Barcode readers (SNAPI, HID), Printers (EPSON, FUJITSU), implementation of Common Libraries and Trace Log files etc. System Performance Analysis of CIM5Board and PC (Fedora22- using kickstart), Oracle and Ubuntu.
